_about: Public-domain Augustus Woodbury (1825-1895), Unitarian minister of the Westminster Congregational Church, Providence, and chaplain of the First Rhode Island Regiment, for the Word Hoard: Plain Words to Young Men, The Divine Unity, his Civil War and Lincoln sermons, The Character and Influence of American Civilization, and his narratives of the First Rhode Island Regiment and of Burnside and the Ninth Army Corps. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 107 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
